name: How long does an open-floor-plan conversion project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an open-floor-plan conversion project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an open-floor-plan conversion depends on the project's complexity. A straightforward removal of non-load-bearing walls might be completed in 3-6 weeks. However, if structural engineering is required for load-bearing walls, permits need to be secured, and significant alterations to flooring, electrical, or HVAC systems are involved, the project could extend to 2-4 months or more. This duration includes design, permitting, demolition, construction, and finishing stages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines range from 3-6 weeks for simple conversions to 2-4 months or longer for complex structural changes and finishing work.
